profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Out of the box thinker and tinkerer. Building things is my passion - from camper vans to companies, from 3D printers to software.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Building the best file viewing experience in Google Drive.

positions.title: Cofounder, CTO, Software Engineer
positions.description:
I built a functioning prototype of a low-cost inkjet 3D printer. I was responsible for every aspect of the design and build process; from coding the firmware, slicer and computer vision system to the electrical and mechanical design.

Architected and implemented software for 3D printer including:
Developed UI in Flask to display files from headless Raspberry Pi. Developed firmware controlling motors, heater, pressure system, and SPI communication between micro-controllers.
Slicer to preprocess print files and generate support material files. Automated backend system to integrate with Onshape's API to manipulate CAD files.

Computer Vision
Developed computer vision system using OpenCV to create 3D reconstruction of print surface.
Explored face scanning techniques for custom eyewear including:
Geometric algorithms using CNN's to locate landmarks
Deep learning methods with Tensorflow to map facial features Various third party face scanning API's

positions.title: Mechatronics Engineer
positions.description:
7-month contract position
Responsible for designing, fabricating, and managing the development of a small-scale continuous electroplating system
As Xtalic's only non-chemical engineer, responsibilities also included designing and building various test equipment for the research lab

positions.title: Product Engineer
positions.description:
Designed complex sheet metal geometry and vac-formed parts for the facade of slot machines.

Led weekly meetings with engineers, artists, and manufacturers to ensure designs were ready for high volume production

positions.title: Mechanical Engineer
positions.description:
Small start-up with ambitious goal of developing low cost metal 3D printers

In charge of mechanical design, CAD documentation, and fabrication for prototypes

Designed machined metal, laser-cut acrylic, and plastic 3D printed parts

positions.title: Process Engineering Intern
positions.description:
-Worked on pickle & anneal lines on rolled steel
-calculated and helped manage different parameters on the line such as titration rates, line speeds,    furnace temperature 
-Developed excel tools to eliminate hand calculations

positions.title: Materials Science co-op
positions.description:
-Work with Tungsten Carbine and Colbalt Powder production lines
-Collect and analyze live data streams from production line to identify unknown trends

positions.title: Research
positions.description:
- Grew graphene by CVD on copper and nickel alloys
- Transferred graphene samples to various substrates.
- Categorized samples with optical microscopy and RAMAN
